description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'ConditionChecker' that provides various static methods for validating method arguments and conditions, such as null checks, emptiness checks for strings and collections, and predicate-based validations. It is used within a larger software project to enforce preconditions and validate inputs in a consistent manner.

classes.name: ConditionChecker
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods for argument and condition validation.

methods.name: checkNotNull
methods.description: Checks that the provided object reference is not null, throws NullPointerException if null.

methods.name: checkNotNull (overload with argumentName)
methods.description: Same as above, but with a custom message including the argument name.

methods.name: checkNotEmpty (CharSequence)
methods.description: Checks that the character sequence is not empty, throws IllegalArgumentException if empty.

methods.name: checkNotEmpty (CharSequence, argumentName)
methods.description: Same as above, with custom message.

methods.name: checkNotEmpty (Collection)
methods.description: Checks that the collection is not empty, throws IllegalArgumentException if empty.

methods.name: checkNotEmpty (Collection, argumentName)
methods.description: Same as above, with custom message.

methods.name: checkArgument
methods.description: Checks an argument against a predicate, throws IllegalArgumentException if predicate is false.

methods.name: checkArgument (with message supplier)
methods.description: Same as above, with custom message provided by a supplier.

methods.name: argumentNotNull
methods.description: Ensures argument is not null, throws IllegalArgumentException if null.

methods.name: argumentNotNull (with argumentName)
methods.description: Same as above, with custom message including argument name.

methods.name: argumentNotEmpty (CharSequence)

methods.name: argumentNotEmpty (CharSequence, argumentName)
methods.description: Same as above, with custom message.
